rationale: The source is a format choice for dates, times, and numbers (RegionalFormat), not a general region setting. 地域形式 names the configured format more precisely than 地域設定.

rationale: The caller exports a native MilkDrop preset. 기본 사전 설정 reads as a default/basic preset; it changes the source meaning. 네이티브 프리셋 preserves the native-format sense.

rationale: This is the Recent Attempts subheader in Lidarr import history. Neuere is comparative (“newer”); Letzte Versuche is the natural label for the most recent attempts.
The current Korean output adds a space before the colon (“{label} :”), unlike the source template. Removing it preserves the same data and matches ordinary Korean punctuation spacing.

currentTarget: تمكين مزامنة الألبوم المطلوب Lidarr وإعدادات استيراد التنزيل المكتمل. لا تزال المزامنة المباشرة تعمل فقط من خلال إجراءات Lidarr الصريحة أو برامج الجدولة التي تم تكوينها.
rationale: The tooltip describes wanted albums inside Lidarr. The current singular الألبوم المطلوب Lidarr leaves the product relation unexpressed; الألبومات المطلوبة في Lidarr makes the setting clear.
recommendedTarget: فعّل مزامنة الألبومات المطلوبة في Lidarr وإعدادات استيراد التنزيلات المكتملة. وتظل المزامنة المباشرة تعمل فقط عبر إجراءات Lidarr الصريحة أو المهام المجدولة المُهيأة.
source: Enable Lidarr wanted-album sync and completed-download import settings. Live sync still runs only from explicit Lidarr actions or configured schedulers.

currentTarget: Activez les paramètres de synchronisation des albums recherchés Lidarr et d'importation des téléchargements terminés. La synchronisation en direct s'exécute toujours uniquement à partir d'actions Lidarr explicites ou de planificateurs configurés.
rationale: The current phrase albums recherchés Lidarr is missing the relation to Lidarr and reads unnaturally. The proposal states which albums are synchronized and preserves the tooltip’s completed-download and live-sync constraints.
recommendedTarget: Activez la synchronisation des albums recherchés dans Lidarr et l’importation des téléchargements terminés. La synchronisation en direct ne se déclenche toujours qu’à partir d’actions explicites de Lidarr ou de tâches planifiées configurées.
source: Enable Lidarr wanted-album sync and completed-download import settings. Live sync still runs only from explicit Lidarr actions or configured schedulers.

currentTarget: Lidarr वांछित-एल्बम सिंक और पूर्ण-डाउनलोड आयात सेटिंग्स सक्षम करें। लाइव सिंक अभी भी केवल स्पष्ट Lidarr क्रियाओं या कॉन्फ़िगर किए गए शेड्यूलर से चलता है।
rationale: The current compound Lidarr वांछित-एल्बम सिंक is a literal fragment and obscures that Lidarr is where albums are marked wanted. में वांछित एल्बमों का सिंक makes that relationship explicit.
recommendedTarget: Lidarr में वांछित एल्बमों का सिंक और पूरे हो चुके डाउनलोड के आयात की सेटिंग सक्षम करें। लाइव सिंक अब भी केवल स्पष्ट Lidarr कार्रवाइयों या कॉन्फ़िगर किए गए शेड्यूलर से चलता है।
source: Enable Lidarr wanted-album sync and completed-download import settings. Live sync still runs only from explicit Lidarr actions or configured schedulers.

currentTarget: Lidarr 원하는 앨범 동기화 및 다운로드 완료 가져오기 설정을 활성화합니다. 라이브 동기화는 여전히 명시적인 Lidarr 작업 또는 구성된 스케줄러에서만 실행됩니다.
rationale: The current Lidarr 원하는 앨범 동기화 lacks a natural Korean particle and reads as a broken compound. Lidarr의 원하는 앨범 동기화 states the possessive relationship and preserves the settings meaning.
recommendedTarget: Lidarr의 원하는 앨범 동기화와 완료된 다운로드 가져오기 설정을 활성화합니다. 실시간 동기화는 여전히 명시적인 Lidarr 작업 또는 구성된 스케줄러에서만 실행됩니다.
